answer: What survives to the wharf is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the ledge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the dune re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
